# La Famiglia Rana UK

> > Authentic Italian fresh pasta and ready meals from Giovanni Rana's family tradition, featuring filled tortelloni, ravioli, gnocchi, and quick Italian recipes.

La Famiglia Rana brings Italian fresh pasta heritage to the UK market with products like Spinach & Ricotta Tortelloni, Mushroom & Mascarpone varieties, and pan-fry gnocchi. The site showcases the Giovanni Rana family story, product range, quick-cooking recipes, and past culinary experiences including their London Marylebone pop-up grocer.

## Key Topics

- La Famiglia Rana
- Giovanni Rana
- Fresh filled pasta
- Tortelloni (Spinach & Ricotta, Mushroom & Mascarpone)
- Italian cuisine
- Parmigiano Reggiano P.D.O.
- Quick-cooking pasta (10-15 minutes)
- Egg pasta
- Gnocchi

- Italian recipes
- Easy entertaining
- Pasta workshops
- Marylebone London pop-up

## Quick Italian Recipes

- [Spinach & Ricotta Tortelloni with Gorgonzola P.D.O. & Walnut Sauce](https://www.rana.co.uk/recipes/spinach-ricotta-tortelloni-gorgonzola-pdo-walnut-sauce): Quick tortelloni with Gorgonzola P.D.O. and walnut sauce
- [Spinach & Ricotta Tortelloni with Tuna, Dried Tomatoes, Provolone Cheese and Mint](https://www.rana.co.uk/recipes/spinach-ricotta-tortelloni-tuna-dried-tomatoes-provolone-cheese-and-mint): Quick 5-10 min tortelloni with tuna, tomatoes and Provolone cheese
- [Mushroom & Ricotta Tortelloni with Cream Mushrooms Soup](https://www.rana.co.uk/recipes/cream-mushroom-soup-mushroom-mascarpone-tortelloni): Mushroom Tortelloni in creamy mushroom soup for weeknight dinner
- [Mushroom & Mascarpone Tortelloni with Walnuts, Ham & Thyme](https://www.rana.co.uk/recipes/mushroom-mascarpone-tortelloni-walnuts-ham-thyme): 10-15 min Mushroom Mascarpone Tortelloni with walnuts and ham

## Seasonal & Special Occasion Recipes

- [Spinach & Ricotta Tortelloni with Butter Fried Sage and Corn-Parmigiano Crisp](https://www.rana.co.uk/recipes/spinach-ricotta-tortelloni-butter-fried-sage-and-corn-parmigiano-crisp): Tortelloni recipe with butter sage sauce and Parmigiano crisp (10-15 min)
- [Mushroom & Mascarpone Tortelloni with Mascarpone Cream, Pomegranate and Thyme](https://www.rana.co.uk/recipes/mushroom-mascarpone-tortelloni-mascarpone-cream-pomegranate-and-thyme): Christmas tortelloni with mascarpone cream and pomegranate (15-30 min)
- [Autumn Crunch Ravioli](https://www.rana.co.uk/recipes/autumn-crunch-ravioli): Butternut Squash Ravioli with Cavolo Nero and Gorgonzola recipe
- [Spinach & Ricotta Tortelloni with Sauté Artichokes, Shrimps and Orange](https://www.rana.co.uk/recipes/spinach-ricotta-tortelloni-saute-artichokes-shrimps-and-orange): Tortelloni with shrimp, artichokes and orange sauce recipe (10-15 min)
- [Spinach & Ricotta Tortelloni with Smoked Salmon, Citrus Zests and Breadcrumbs](https://www.rana.co.uk/recipes/spinach-ricotta-tortelloni-smoked-salmon-citrus-zests-and-breadcrumbs): Tortelloni with smoked salmon, citrus zest and breadcrumbs topping
